rationale: The parties have clarified the economics and the no-closure-versus-closure tradeoff, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and Lower Saxony still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist on proof of equivalent savings that has not been provided. Rounds 3 and 4 show hardened positions with repeated requests for the same quantified comparison, so further open-ended discussion is likely to circle unless a structured expert-led intervention supplies the missing plant-level numbers.
